title: Dekker's floating point number system and compensated summation algorithms
summary: The recent hardware trend towards reduced precision computing has reignited the interest in numerical techniques that can be used to enhance the accuracy of floating point operations beyond what is natively supported for basic arithmetic operations on the hardware. In this work, we study the behavior of various compensated summation techniques, which can be used to enhance the accuracy for the summation operation, particularly in situations when the addends are not known a priori.
